# fluidsynth

Bindings to libfluidsynth to play and render midi files. See
<https://docs.ropensci.org/fluidsynth>

## Installation

You can install the development version of fluidsynth with:

``` r

install.packages("fluidsynth", repos = 'https://ropensci.r-universe.dev')
```

On Debian/Ubuntu you need to install `libfluidsynth-dev` first:

``` sh
sudo apt-get install libfluidsynth-dev
```

And on Fedora you need:

``` sh
sudo dnf install fluidsynth-dev
```

On RHEL/CentOS/RockyLinux you first need to enable EPEL:

``` sh
yum install -y epel-release
sudo yum install fluidsynth-dev
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`midi_play()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/fluidsynth/reference/fluidsynth.md)
  [`midi_convert()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/fluidsynth/reference/fluidsynth.md)
  [`midi_read()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/fluidsynth/reference/fluidsynth.md)
  [`demo_midi()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/fluidsynth/reference/fluidsynth.md)
  : Play or convert a midi file
- [`fluidsynth_setting_list()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/fluidsynth/reference/fluidsynth_settings.md)
  [`fluidsynth_setting_options()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/fluidsynth/reference/fluidsynth_settings.md)
  [`fluidsynth_setting_default()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/fluidsynth/reference/fluidsynth_settings.md)
  [`libfluidsynth_version()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/fluidsynth/reference/fluidsynth_settings.md)
  : Fluidsynth settings
- [`soundfont_path()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/fluidsynth/reference/soundfonts.md)
  [`soundfont_download()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/fluidsynth/reference/soundfonts.md)
  : Managing soundfonts
